verdict.rationale: BugSnag's release docs say you can filter the dashboard by release, identify which release errors were introduced in, and see release annotations on the error timeline. The CLI can also create builds that enrich release data. Nothing in the evidence shows commit association or suspect-commit attribution on issues, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: suspect-commit identification per issue, evidence of linking commits to releases or errors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
